trace.question:
I haven't sent any payment yet. You asked me to pay Fjord Analytics's approved invoice, but two of their invoices are approved:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-88888 | $4,166.42 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-77132 | $6,245.39 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |

Fjord Analytics has two other invoices that aren't ready to pay: INV-83110 ($3,783.75) is already marked paid, and INV-95654 ($3,555.09) is a draft still waiting for approval.

I checked and nothing has gone out from the operating account yet, so neither approved invoice has been paid. Since you asked for one payment made exactly once, I don't want to guess which invoice you meant.

Tell me which one to pay (or both). I'll send it in full by wire, or by ACH if wire isn't available, and report the payment details. Both are under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval.

trace.message: Pay INV-77132, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-77132 in full by wire, once.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-77132 (Fjord Analytics), due 2026-11-25
- **Amount:** $6,245.39
- **Method:** Wire from the operating account
- **Status:** Sent and verified, and the invoice is marked paid

I attached a one-time key to the request, so if it were accidentally repeated, the system would block a second payment. I didn't touch INV-88888, the earlier invoice you said is under dispute ($4,166.42, due 2026-11-04).
